ZOL increased BMD and bone strength, as assessed by QCT, vs placebo.
the HORIZON QCT study demonstrated that ZOL 5 mg once-yearly significantly increased BMD in the spine and hip, and increased indices of compression strength in the femoral neck and trochanter.

The main takeaway from our work is that
QCT is a more sensitive technique to assess the effects of ZOL on bone strength.
